dialogue.content: Watered the balcony herbs. Basil is finally upright.
Small wins count.
Resoled my walking shoes. Feels less slapdash.
Good maintenance habit.
Weekday mornings I stick to a flat park loop. When I cut through steeper neighborhood streets, my right knee starts complaining.
Flat comfort plus steeper-street discomfort points to incline load as the trigger.
Yeah. Soft paths are fine; the hills are not.
A quiet evening with a podcast. No drama.
Low-key recovery counts.
Coworker group chat is hyping a ridge trail team signup this month — everyone saying it is amazing.
Signup FOMO around trail events is loud.
Someone asked if joining the ridge trail team is worth it for networking.
Networking and elevation load are different questions.
Sky was grey. Stayed in with a book.
Quiet evening material.
Neighbor mentioned a spring craft fair. I saved the flyer without committing.
Fairs are tempting calendar items.
Worth joining the ridge trail team signup this month — based on what you know about me?
